title: Lycian Way Trail, Point, Storytelling and Audio Dataset (TRAIL – Lycian Odyssey)
description:
Open datasets of the TRAIL – Lycian Odyssey Digital Rural–Urban Enabler, developed by ATAM Technology, Artemis Outdoor and Antalya SKAL within the RURBANIVE Open Call (Horizon Europe, grant agreement 101136597).

Dataset 1 – Lycian Way Trail, Segment, Point and Cultural Storytelling Dataset: 41 published Lycian Way stages with route geometry, 44 original segments, 399 points of interest with categories, practical resources and hazards, and the texts of 37 location-linked cultural stories, in GeoJSON and CSV with a field dictionary.

Dataset 2 – Lycian Odyssey Audio Dataset: 35 narrated cultural stories in MP3 with metadata and transcripts.

Coordinates in WGS 84. Language: English. Coverage: Lycian Way corridor, provinces of Antalya (TR611) and Muğla (TR323), Türkiye.
